Thank you for helping improve the public primer. Please submit only material that is appropriate for a public repository.

## Area

Which stage, template, page, example, or guide were you using?

## Artifact

Name the file, section, or page.

## Task

What were you trying to accomplish?

## Observation

What was unclear, inaccessible, broken, or difficult?

## Expected outcome

What would have made the artifact clearer or more useful?

## Impact

Choose one: blocked completion / meaningful ambiguity / slowed completion / minor issue.

## Environment

Include browser, device, assistive technology, or Markdown renderer when relevant.

## Suggested change

Optional.

## Public-boundary confirmation

- [ ] I have not included confidential information, private system material, client information, credentials, or personal conversations.
